package.description: Create an Interactive Presentation with Poll Everywhere

en-US.description: Create an Interactive Presentation with Poll Everywhere
en-US.longDescription: Poll Everywhere’s PowerPoint integration bridges this gap, transforming static presentations into dynamic, two-way conversations. With live polling, Q&As, Word Clouds, and other interactive features, you can seamlessly engage your audience directly within your slides. This integration empowers presenters to gather real-time input, spark dialogue, and keep audiences actively involved throughout the session. It’s the ideal way to ensure that the audience’s voice is heard.
en-US.name: Poll Everywhere

zh-CN.description: 使用 Poll Everywhere 创建互动演示文稿
zh-CN.longDescription: Poll Everywhere 的 PowerPoint 集成功能填补了这一空白，将静态演示转变为动态的双向交流。通过实时投票、问答、词云及其他互动功能，您可以在幻灯片中直接无缝地吸引观众参与。此集成使演示者能够实时收集反馈，激发对话，并让观众在整个过程中保持积极参与。这是确保观众声音被听到的理想方式。
